item.text: {"search_note":"I found little direct 2024 evidence on the most specific part of this lens, namely whether Abiy used jobs, permits, or housing as routine loyalty rewards or punishments. The strongest evidence instead came from adjacent behaviors: emergency detention, forced evictions, aid diversion, refugee exclusion, and censorship.
